integrity: The explicit modular certificates were reconstructed and checked. Published integral homology, connectivity, and orbit-space theorems are cited premises, not new results; independent audit not performed.
limitations: Specific to the 5-by-5 chessboard complex and its order-two transpose quotient; the wedge theorem is three-local, and two-primary quotient phenomena are unresolved.
title: Three-local torsion cancellation in the transpose quotient of the five-by-five chessboard complex
